description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only: submit an internal memo that cites facts by key (survey, forecast, panel_b). Accepted -> YES WITH EVIDENCE + a receipt. Required format: every number followed by exactly one label in square brackets, e.g. 'Survey: 31.2% [KNOWN] plan to cut holiday spending. The model forecasts +2.1% [INFERRED]; Panel B projects +0.4% [CONFLICTED].' Anything else is refused with instructions. The check is pattern-based, not semantic, and can miss paraphrases. Accepted memos return a short handoff_code for the visitor.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.

purpose.description: Why you want this, in your own words.

text.description: The memo text. Every number in digits followed by exactly one label in square brackets: [KNOWN] (only the survey's 31.2%), [INFERRED] (the 2.1% forecast) or [CONFLICTED] (Panel B's 0.4%), e.g. 'the model forecasts +2.1% [INFERRED]'.

name: atlas.pulse_memo
title: Pulse memo
